metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the sentence said over in the dark, the entrance judged by daylight, and two facts about the work.

yesterday: The sentence stands, and you did not decide it. You looked at the hand, not the face.
The purse was before the last speech. Nicholas and Arthur were thanked by name. He rose with the women.
The Queen was late in the garden. The groom held, on six paces. The three leaves are still in the chest.
Two Gentlemen was the afternoon bill. You were not in it.
